title: Pointer to the properties of [def-sc-isogeny]
text:
In the notation of [def-sc-isogeny], the following holds. That such
an $f$ is finite and flat of finite rank, and that the degree of
the finite flat morphism $f$ is then the order of the kernel, is
[lem-sc-isogeny-degree], and it is not part of this
definition.
